Role:

BatFast is a leader in global sports technology. Founded in 2016 to increase participation in sports worldwide. We use data, augmented reality technology, machine learning, and robotics to re-engineer how sports are played. We use technology to change the game. With data and patented technology, we’ve made sports more accessible for beginners and aspiring professionals alike - whether you're here to play, complete, or improve.

We currently innovate, design, develop, and build multisport simulators for training and entertainment industries. We have a great pipeline of products and features we are working on over the next few years. There will be many aspects of the business to get involved in within our highly dynamic, passionate, and ever-growing team.

The BatFast team is looking for a multi-skilled candidate with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Services & Operations manager, who will help coordinate, develop and innovate the operational function within the business.

Responsibilities

? Innovation

- Advocate for sharing best practices and insights with other teams.

- Independently execute projects & initiatives, involving and delegating tasks to the team for collective success.

- Utilise cross-functional feedback to establish innovative and standardised approaches to work.

- Motivate the BatFast team members to share and fully implement new ideas

? Product Delivery

- Project manage installations in coordination with the Supply Chain Manager.

- Develop maintenance and service systems in line with site/machine requirements, working closely with the technical department.

- Train staff internally and externally on installation, production, assembly &

maintenance service as required.

- Development of risk assessments and health & safety systems.

- Foster a spirit of continuous improvement within the Operations team.

- Proactively identify and resolve obstacles for the team and ensure all SLAs are met.

- Implement standard practices with the team to ensure procedures are followed consistently

- Maintain high standards when ensuring all systems are utilised correctly by BatFast team members

- Play a crucial role in the successful execution of various large-scale and strategic programs and projects, engaging all stakeholders.

- Ensure clear project plans are agreed upon by the team.

? Client Success

- Drive client onboarding processes.

- Manage hands-on activities of the team, including assembly, deliveries, installations & packaging.

- Manage B2B customer relationships and ensure customer success.

- Support installations as required - finding suppliers, reducing installation time, and shipping costs.

- Effectively address challenges raised by stakeholders, to ensure a seamless client experience.

- Manage client expectations using product knowledge & experience.

- Establish targets for client service excellence, including NPS scores, and communicate them clearly to the entire team.

- Confidently handle client challenges and resolve issues to promote client success.

? Team

- Build, recruit, train and manage agency staff and interns supporting installations, production & maintenance.

- Collaborate with the Technical department and Supply Chain Manager to improve the production/assembly process.

- Provide operational leadership support for investment and raise conversations.

- Assist BatFast team members to develop individual skills.

- Provide mentorship and support to junior team members.

About You:

? Experience

- Relevant qualification such as Business, or equivalent professional experience.

- 5 years working in industry, (project management/client relationships)

- International experience - Collaborating with diverse stakeholders, managing global projects and navigating cross-cultural environments effectively.

- Tooling experience - the role involves working with specialised equipment and tools integral to the production and assembly processes.

- Understanding of the Sport industry - All 3 sports (Cricket, Baseball, & Tennis)

? Innovative thinking

- Ability to find creative solutions to challenges and adapt to changing market demands, by implementing new ideas.Adaptability

? Adaptability

- With shifting market trends, evolving customer preferences, and technological advancements, you must be adaptable to embrace change, and pivot strategies when necessary.

? Communication

- Effective communication is essential to convey expectations, align team members, and collaborate with various stakeholders.

? Team Management and Collaboration

- Effective team management involves motivating and empowering team members to achieve shared objectives.

- Openness to help the business in other departments in busy periods not directly linked to Services and Operations.

Extended Responsibilities

? Operational Strategy Delivery

- Take responsibility for supporting the implementation of BatFast’s operational strategy, ensuring that day to day operations and international projects are aligned and within budget.

- Create and implement a sustainable support and service structure for the Australian market ensuring budget constraints are met.

- Own and manage BatFast Australia stock to meet cost efficiency measures.

- Create Australia's supply chain for cost effective and scalable deployment

? Resource and Supply Planning Responsibility

- Responsible for building the Operations team in Australia in a cost-effective manner, such that the business is profitable and can scale.

- Be accountable for providing accurate data, forecasts and recommendations to inform operational resources and supply planning in line with the sales pipeline. Ensure resource plans are delivered effectively within assigned projects.

- Report and monitor client performance metrics, usage patterns, SLA’s and satisfaction levels to ensure optimal outcomes and proactively address any issues before they impact the relationship.

? Client Success Ownership

- Supporting commercially for region wide business developments as and when requested to ensure the success of BatFast in Australia

- Take responsibility for identifying and resolving operational barriers that may affect

client delivery within international projects, ensuring issues are escalated appropriately and client expectations are met.

? Budget Responsibility

- Monitor and track costs within assigned projects, ensuring efficiencies are achieved and escalating budgetary concerns where required, escalating financial decisions to the Head of operations

- Clear focus on reducing costs to supply, install, train, service and maintain for the Australian business to be successful in scaling

? Team Mentorship & Coaching

- Provide day to day coaching, guidance and support for operational team members and agency staff on-site, enabling effective delivery of installations, services and maintenance.

- Full performance management accountability for all staff locally

? Account Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all BatFast Australian clients, building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.

- Proactively identify and close opportunities to grow revenues with existing clients

- Take accountability for revenue growth from existing Australian accounts, and achieve annual revenue growth & NPS targets

- Oversee contract renewals, negotiations, and variations, ensuring terms are mutually beneficial and support long-term partnerships

What Does Success Look Like

Y1

? Hitz Australia sites launched in-line with contract volumes and business plan

? Cost effective and scalable operations model for: ? Installations

? Service and maintenance

? Support

? Cost effective and scalable supply chain established for: ? Fabricated items

? Out of scope items

? Target and control boxes

? Stock management and logistics process established

? Achieve and accurately report:- ? NPS >8 for new clients

? Agreed SLA’s and

result.description:
Your Opportunity
We currently have exciting opportunities for Senior Consultant, Managers, Senior Managers and Directors across our Tax division.

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
Our Corporate Tax division helps businesses understand corporate tax matters and comply with ATO filing obligations. We recognise that multinational businesses face obstacles in managing tax across different jurisdictions and we use our local and global expertise to cut through the complexity this entails. 

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
The KPMG State Tax Deals and Stamp Duty teams work on the most significant transactions in the Australian Market. They are market leading teams supporting clients with tax due diligence, structuring, modelling, duty and land tax compliance and dispute resolutions. 

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
Our Indirect Tax division within the KPMG Specialist Tax and Reward business consists of market leading teams that provide high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services. We support clients across the market through consulting on FBT, payroll tax, superannuation obligations, GST advice and international trade strategy.

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
Our Global Mobility Services teams are part of the KPMG People Services business in Australia and offers both Australian and international tax services to clients. We work across all areas of Global Mobility and related tax matters providing a high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services to our clients.

Performance & Reward
KPMG’s Performance & Reward team is our leading remuneration practice advising ASX200 and unlisted company Boards and C-Site on remuneration and reward issues. We help our clients implement remuneration plans to reward and retain their people.

Migration DDX
Our national immigration practice is a team of registered migration agents and administrators that manage the visa requirements involved in the relocation of individuals and their families from one country to another by working closely with taxation specialists and global mobility professionals. 

Transfer Pricing 
Our Transfer Pricing Services practice is an international team of economists, tax practitioners and analysts helping clients generate tax efficiencies and reduce the risk of challenges from revenue authorities. Our multi-disciplinary approach and global mindset enable us to cover issues such as developing and executing commercially viable transfer pricing policies, compiling documentation for revenue authority audits and complying with local revenue requirements.

Tax Governance & Transparency
The Tax Governance & Transparency team advises organisations nationally and internationally on better practices in respect of tax governance and sustainability through tax transparency and risk management disciplines. 

Tax Reimagined
Our Tax Transformation team assist clients in transforming their tax functions to increase efficiency, improve governance and accuracy of their tax reporting. 

Tax Controversy
Our Tax Controversy team complements KPMG's traditional service offerings by providing high-quality legal services to our clients. The team prepare for, manage and resolve tax disputes, whilst maintaining an effective working relationship with revenue authorities.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You actively seek out opportunities for growth, are comfortable challenging the status quo, and enjoy getting out of your comfort zone

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
•	Advisory and compliance experience
•	High level of commitment to quality client service
•	Preferably CA/CPA qualified or with a Master’s of Taxation.

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
•	Demonstrated experience as a Finance/Accounting/Law professional, ideally with significant recent experience in duty in an M&A/ transactional tax environment
•	You are passionate about the importance of fantastic communication to share ideas, inspire and create change. You are able to digest, distil, and communicate complex concepts in both written and verbal forms.

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
•	A degree in Accounting, Commerce or other relevant disciplines
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems.,

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
•	Experience with expatriate tax compliance issues, with strong Tax compliance knowledge, including preparation and/or review of company and trust income tax returns, distribution reviews and tax provisions

Performance & Reward
•	A broad mix of technical knowledge suited to working in the Leadership, Performance and Reward space
•	Sector experience within consulting, a large listed corporate, or government
•	You like to be proud of the work you produce and are accountable and committed to owning high-profile projects.

Migration DDX
•	Must be a Registered Migration Agent with sound understanding of migration legislation in a high-volume environment
•	You are committed to providing fantastic customer service, with kindness and empathy at the heart of every interaction.

Transfer Pricing 
•	Prior transfer pricing experience in a Big 4 or mid-tier firm, the ATO or corporate environment
•	A degree in Accounting, Economics, Commerce, Finance or Law, and/or undertaking/completion of the CA/CPA

Tax Governance & Transparency
•	Tertiary qualifications in a related discipline such as Business, Tax, Law, Audit or Finance / Commerce
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines.

Tax Reimagined
•	A tertiary qualification (preferably Finance/Accounting and/or Maths/ Computer Science related) will be viewed favourably, with previous Indirect Tax Technology implementation experience
•	Expertise in defining and/or configuring tax logic and content within third-party tax solutions (ONESOURCE, Vertex or equivalent)
•	ERP Technology implementation experience (preferably SAP, Oracle, Workday or NetSuite) – ideally in Tax
•	You actively seek out opportunities for growth, are comfortable challenging the status quo, and enjoy getting out of your comfort zone.

Tax Controversy
•	Previous experience in corporate tax, international tax, tax law and/or tax dispute resolution and controversy in either a Big 4 professional services firm, a law firm or the Australian Taxation Office.
•	Ability to quickly establish a high level of stakeholder engagement, and able to hold the role of an advisor to the business and be an expert on a topical area(s) of tax law
•	Ability to integrate information from a variety of different sources, consider the broader impact of issues and how it will affect the project, engagement and the business

Type: Full-time
Employer: Grace Morgan 1 Pty Ltd
Location: Penshurst NSW 2222
Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 p/a
About the Business:
Grace Morgan 1 Pty Ltd operates as Empowered Early Learning Academy, a reputable provider of high-quality childcare and early education services in Penshurst for children aged 0–5 years. Our purpose-built centre delivers a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment where every child feels supported, confident, and excited to learn. We pride ourselves on building strong relationships, delivering small group learning, and providing individualised care that supports each child’s unique development. Our values centre on excellence in early childhood education, child safety, and family partnership in a supportive, collaborative workplace culture that empowers staff to grow professionally while making a meaningful difference in young lives.
About the Position:
The Childcare Worker plays a vital role at Empowered Early Learning Academy by providing attentive, high-quality care and educational support to children aged 0–5 years. Working as part of a dedicated team, you will contribute to creating a positive daily experience that promotes children’s social, emotional, physical, and cognitive development while ensuring their safety and wellbeing at all times. This position is essential to maintaining the centre’s reputation for excellence in early childhood education.
Key Responsibilities:
Assisting in the preparation of materials and equipment for children’s education and recreational activities
Managing children’s behaviour and guiding children’s social development
Preparing and conducting activities for children
Entertaining children by reading and playing games
Supervising children in recreational activities
Supervising the daily routine of children
Supervising the hygiene of children
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Early Childhood Education & Care and a Diploma of Early Childhood Education & Care.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
Strong technical skills in planning and delivering age-appropriate activities, along with excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage effectively with children, families, and team members.
Demonstrated ability to create a nurturing environment and respond thoughtfully to children’s individual needs.
Passion for early childhood development and commitment to child safety and inclusive practices.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP, a leader in the wearable tech space, empowers its members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Marketing Director, ANZ - to own and execute a fully integrated regional marketing and commercial strategy that drives brand affinity and omni-channel growth. This role serves as the executional owner for the ANZ region, with responsibility for translating global strategies into regionally relevant, culturally resonant programs. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role partners closely with cross-functional teams to align strategy, execution, and performance across the ANZ markets.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

? Own execution and performance of regional omni-channel commercial targets, translating strategic marketing and sales plans into outcomes that deliver both brand and business KPIs.

? Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that align WHOOP with key cultural moments, regional trends, and community-driven movements, particularly within fitness, wellness, sports, and lifestyle verticals.

? Identify and activate opportunities around mainstream cultural events (e.g., major sporting events, holidays, industry conferences) to deepen brand relevance and drive buzz at local and national levels.

? Lead cross-functional collaboration with Brand, Social, and Partnerships teams to amplify culturally relevant storytelling and ensure cohesive brand messaging across channels.

? Build and maintain strategic relationships with local fitness studios, athletic organizations, wellness influencers, and community leaders to authentically embed WHOOP within target communities.

? Own WHOOP’s grassroots presence in key cities by planning and executing on-the-ground activations, pop-ups, brand experiences, and community events that drive member acquisition, product engagement, and loyalty.

? Own analysis and reporting on campaign impact, community growth, and regional performance to inform future initiatives and improve effectiveness.

? Own regional media strategy and execution in partnership with global leads to ensure effective channel mix and budget allocation.

? Collaborate on regional influencer, creator, and affiliate partnerships to increase brand visibility and conversion.

? Support wholesale expansion and optimise channel performance in coordination with internal sales and trade marketing teams.

? Localise global brand campaigns and creative assets, ensuring cultural nuance, seasonality and alignment with ANZ market dynamics.

? Activate sports and talent marketing strategies within ANZ, identifying opportunities for regional relevance and performance impact.

? Execute global and regional partnerships, product launches, and PR campaigns to drive engagement and cultural connection in the ANZ market.

QUALIFICATIONS

? 8+ years of experience in marketing, including ownership of regional initiatives, preferably within consumer tech, fitness, wellness, or lifestyle brands.

? Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or a closely related field

? Deep understanding of the ANZ market - media, commercial and competitive landscapes- with demonstrated cultural fluency and insight into consumer behaviour.

? Proven experience across influencer marketing, media planning, and brand partnerships.

? Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret commercial performance data and inform strategic decisions.

? Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives through cross-functional collaboration and influence.

? Critical thinker with great problem solving abilities to identify areas of opportunity and improvement on a consistent basis.

? Strong relationship management and communication skills, comfortable holding both partners and internal stakeholders accountable

? Team player but works well independently to balance looking at the larger picture at hand with prioritisation of day to day initiatives.

? Adaptable and thrives in a dynamic and fast moving business

? Is comfortable with constant change, is self motivated and collaborative.

? Demonstrated passion for performance, wellness, and WHOOP’s mission.

LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES:

? Expertise: Expert at core job responsibilities, seen as an expert/leader by other peers. Solves large, complex problems independently and leads company-wide projects and cross-functional efforts with little guidance

? Collaboration: Establishes clear direction for the team and leads the execution

? Communication: Expresses complicated issues simply to others. Solicits and integrates feedback to improve performance with limited guidance; proactively remedies communication issues

? Influence: Effectively manages cross-functional leads to increase marketing impact for the country. Influences other dept. leaders to increase team impact, while setting and maintaining high standards for team results and output

? Innovation: Consistently looking for new ways to approach and improve work.
result.title: ANZ Marketing Director-

About the Business:
Moorookclub Pty Ltd operates Blanchetown Foodery, a vibrant one-stop destination in the heart of Blanchetown, South Australia, encompassing a cafe, restaurant, and supermarket. The business specialises in delivering a diverse multi-cuisine experience, featuring Italian, Indian, and fast-food options alongside everyday grocery needs. Known for its convenient, high-quality offerings and friendly service in a regional community setting, Blanchetown Foodery values fresh ingredients, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence. It fosters a supportive, team-oriented workplace culture where dedication to food service and community connection are highly regarded.
About the Position:
The Chef plays a central role at Blanchetown Foodery within Moorookclub Pty Ltd, leading the preparation and delivery of high-quality dishes across the cafe and restaurant operations. This position involves creating appealing menus, maintaining exceptional food standards, and contributing to the smooth running of a busy multi-cuisine venue that serves both locals and visitors. The role is essential for upholding the business’s reputation for delicious, diverse food and ensuring an outstanding dining experience that supports the venue’s position as a community favourite.
Key Responsibilities:
Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, and ordering food supplies.
Monitoring quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation.
Discussing food preparation issues with Managers, Dietitians and kitchen and waiting staff.
Demonstrating techniques and advising on cooking procedures.
Preparing and cooking food.
Explaining and enforcing hygiene regulations.
Selecting and training staff (as required).
Freezing and preserving foods (as required).
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma in a relevant field (such as Commercial Cookery or Hospitality Management).
Minimum 3 years’ work experience as a Chef.
Strong technical skills in multi-cuisine food preparation (including Italian, Indian, and fast food), menu planning, cost control, and presentation.
Excellent knowledge of food safety, hygiene regulations, and quality standards.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and provide guidance to kitchen staff.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced setting while maintaining attention to detail.
